full_judgment: 2. The petitioners filed the writ petition stating that the disputed 3.71 acres of land was recorded as pathway, homestead and pond in C.S: Khatian No. 18 in "Tofa" right under touzi No. 87 of Noakhali Collectorate. The Government accepting Kabuliyat transferred the said land to the tenants who were in possession. The Government by order dated 3.6.1985 directed the petitioners and others to pay rent for 3.34 acres as no effect was given to that order upon an application filed by the petitioners the Government by order dated 11.10.1996 directed the District Authority to give effect to the order dated 3.6.85 Thereafter the Government issued notices dated 10.5.1988 and 3. 8.1988 stating that in view of the order dated 15.3.1988 no order can be passed in favour of the petitioners. The petitioner challenged orders dated 15.3.1988, 10.5.1988 and 3.8.1288 in the writ petition.
